name: Saarani Mohamad
_note: M2 state-executive cohort (Phase 2). Menteri Besar of Perak since Dec 2020 (reappointed 22 Nov 2022). Added as a BN-aligned executive to balance the class. Provisional Layer B anchors pending the blind panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations search-corroborated; reconfirm against primary sources. A5 none-on-record: a 2012 Malay-reserve-land probe references him only as a potential witness, not an accused. B4 and B5 left unscored (no clean policy U-turn; the only 3R-adjacent item is a contested, claimed-edited remark).

metrics.justification: No charge, conviction, or personal MACC case against Saarani is on record; in a 2012 Malay-reserve-land status matter he stated (June 2024) he was ready to cooperate if called as a witness and had not been contacted, with MACC indicating it would call former exco members and lands officers as witnesses. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record.

citation.title: Malay reserve land fraud: Perak MB ready to cooperate with MACC

metrics.justification: He managed a string of service disruptions and floods: an August 2024 water-plant intake failure cut supply to over 10,000 accounts in Muallim (water tankers mobilised), and in the October-November 2025 floods he ordered neighbouring districts to provide logistical aid and kept disaster teams on alert. A documented response with mixed outcomes (anchor 2).

citation.title: Neighbouring districts to aid flood-hit areas in Perak, says Saarani

metrics.justification: Under his Perak Sejahtera 2030 plan the state reported rising approved investments, from RM6.61 billion (2022) to a record RM15.76 billion across 560 projects reported for 2025; the figures are state-government and MIDA releases (an interested party), not an independent audit. Delivered and measurable, though self-reported (anchor 3).

citation.title: MB says Perak future bright with RM6.25b investments to drive jobs, education, healthcare, infrastructure

metrics.justification: From his first budget he reached a power-sharing consensus with Pakatan Harapan assemblymen described as a first in Perak: equal constituency allocations for all assembly members, opposition seats on district and disaster committees, and the Public Accounts Committee chair given to the opposition, a parity he reaffirmed in December 2025. Documented cross-bench institutional practice (anchor 3).

citation.title: Budget consensus shows Perak govt's maturity, says Nga
